name: Mundhwa
civicNote: Under PMC; its remaining Keshav Nagar part was merged in 2017.
summary: A developing residential area in east Pune, about 11 km east of the city centre, between Koregaon Park and Kharadi.
knownFor: Lies between Koregaon Park and the Kharadi office hub
Rapid residential growth together with neighbouring Keshav Nagar
connectivity: Keshavnagar-Kharadi bridge (opened Aug 2026) links the area to Kharadi
Road links to Koregaon Park, Hadapsar and Magarpatta
suits: Professionals working in Kharadi or Magarpatta who want to live between those hubs and Koregaon Park.
